name: How long does a typical utility shutoff last for a plumbing repair?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical utility shutoff last for a plumbing repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a utility shutoff varies depending on the complexity and scope of the plumbing repair. Minor repairs might only require a shutoff for an hour or two, while more extensive projects, like a full pipe replacement, could take several hours. We always aim to complete work efficiently to minimize disruption and will provide an estimated timeframe before beginning any work that requires a shutoff.
acceptedAnswer.description: Utility shutoff duration depends on repair complexity, ranging from one hour for minor fixes to several hours for larger projects. We provide an estimate beforehand.
